n2c721b29e4.headline: Portugal’s June inflation figures down to 3.4% - INE
n2c721b29e4.summary: Portugal's June inflation fell to 3.4%, according to preliminary data from the national statistics institute INE. The figures are subject to confirmation in 12 days.
n2c721b29e4.why: Inflation data shape European Central Bank rate expectations, which affect euro-area bond yields and borrowing costs for Portuguese government and corporate issuers.

nc57ace0785.headline: FNB Partners Banks For Continuous Forex Activities
nc57ace0785.summary: First National Bank Ghana has announced a temporary arrangement with partner banks to complete foreign exchange transactions for and on behalf of the bank.
nc57ace0785.why: First National Bank Ghana is a commercial bank in Ghana, and forex capacity affects its clients' currency transactions. Currency flows matter for Ghana's import-dependent economy.

n8ff02e0bd7.headline: Porto Digital Is the Quixotic Tech Hub That Actually Worked
n8ff02e0bd7.summary: Porto Digital, created in 2000 to halt urban decay in Recife, Brazil, has brought thousands of tech jobs to the region. The initiative is presented as a working model of regional tech development.
n8ff02e0bd7.why: Technology hubs and special innovation districts shape local labour markets, real estate and the growth prospects of tech-services firms in emerging economies.

n50bf6858bc.headline: Europe inflation slips to 5.5% — but that won't stop central bank rate hikes | Business
n50bf6858bc.summary: Annual inflation in the 20 euro-area countries fell to 5.5% from 6.1% in May, Eurostat said, but prices remain persistently high and some central bankers signal further rate hikes.
n50bf6858bc.why: Eurostat is the EU statistics agency, and its inflation readings shape European Central Bank rate expectations, which drive euro-area bond yields and the euro.
n50bf6858bc.why_moved: Inflation falling from 6.1% to 5.5% is a notable downside surprise to price pressures, but officials signaling they will keep rates high limits the reaction in rate expectations.

nf6e87d607f.headline: EC report: Smooth and efficient introduction of the euro in Croatia
nf6e87d607f.summary: A European Commission report issued on June 30 concludes that Croatia's introduction of the euro was smooth and efficient. Croatia joined the euro zone on January 1, 2023.
nf6e87d607f.why: Euro adoption changes monetary policy, currency exposure and borrowing costs for a country, and the European Commission assesses each candidate's readiness.

nc45324c699.headline: Constellation Brands Reports First Quarter Fiscal 2024 Financial Results
nc45324c699.summary: Constellation Brands reported its first-quarter fiscal 2024 financial results on June 30, 2023. The beverage alcohol company is due to hold a conference call to discuss them.
nc45324c699.why: Constellation Brands is a major US beverage alcohol company known for brands such as Modelo and Corona beers in the US market.

n40485d34df.headline: GLOBAL LNG-Asia spot LNG prices flat as demand remains tepid
n40485d34df.summary: Asian spot liquefied natural gas prices held flat this week as demand remained muted and inventories stayed high. The average price for August delivery into north-east Asia was also covered.
n40485d34df.why: LNG is a globally traded gas form whose spot prices in Asia reflect supply, demand and storage conditions that affect energy costs for importers.

n799b5adb81.headline: Double whammy hits London economy on top of house price fall
n799b5adb81.summary: The average cost of a London house is £517,000, down more than 4% in June. The Standard described the fall as a double blow to the London economy.
n799b5adb81.why: House prices affect household wealth, mortgage costs and construction activity, and they feed into UK inflation and interest-rate expectations.

n72ab635201.summary: The Netherlands published new export controls that will restrict more of ASML's chipmaking machines from being sent to China. The rules add to existing limits on advanced chip equipment.
n72ab635201.why: ASML is the Dutch maker of extreme ultraviolet lithography machines, which are essential to producing the most advanced semiconductors. Export restrictions directly affect its sales to China.

n417f632352.why: International lenders often make financing conditional on anti-corruption measures, which affects the terms of Ukraine's external support.
